summary: Macerich Co filed an 8-K reporting entry into underwriting and forward sale agreements for a public offering of 14 million shares of its common stock at an initial forward price of $23.12325 per share, with a 30-day option for up to an additional 2.1 million shares. The company will not initially receive proceeds; it expects to physically settle the forward sales by June 16, 2027, potentially raising cash. This is a common stock offering under an at-the-market forward program, not a transformative special situation. The filing provides no board recommendation or advisor. Watch for any shift to cash or net-share settlement, which could dilute shareholders without inflow.
